about: One point of responsibility for the whole project

When a client hires a designer, a building crew, electricians, HVAC installers and suppliers separately, the client becomes the dispatcher between them — and carries the risk of gaps, delays and overruns. A general contractor takes on that role: one contract with you, all trades organised by us, and one party responsible for the result.

CAS Development has been delivering projects since 2016 — over 150 of them: apartments, houses, offices, restaurants, salons and country complexes. Our team includes designers, engineers, technical supervision and project managers, so design and construction stay aligned.

Before work starts we prepare the estimate and schedule, and fix price, deadlines and payment stages in the contract. If CAS carries out the renovation to our design, the final cost stays within ±5% of the approved estimate.

Every 1–2 weeks we send a photo report from site; concealed works are inspected before they are closed up, and each stage is signed off with a certificate. We invoice companies registered in Ukraine with full closing documents; invoicing for EU companies is being set up.
How much does a general contractor cost

Indicative base rates: turnkey renovation from $550 per m² (works and rough materials; finishing materials, furniture and appliances are estimated separately), office renovation from $350 per m², house construction from $600 per m², turnkey house with finishes from $1 100 per m², design from $30 per m² (minimum $2 500).

For example, the base calculation for a 300 m² office is 300 m² × $350. Restaurants, hotels and projects with complex engineering are priced per project. The exact figure comes from the estimate after a paid site survey; a phone consultation is free.

faq: What does a general contractor do?

Takes responsibility for the whole project: prepares the estimate and schedule, hires and coordinates crews and subcontractors, buys materials, controls quality and deadlines, inspects concealed works and hands over the property with certificates. You deal with one contract and one manager.
Do you take on commercial projects?
Yes: offices, restaurants and cafés, beauty salons, shops, mini-hotels and serviced apartments, resorts. We also deliver private houses and apartments.
Can you build to someone else's design?
Yes. We review the drawings, prepare an estimate and deliver the design, coordinating decisions with its author when needed.
